contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete and very worn copper alloy Roman As of unknown emperor, dating to c.AD 41-260. Unclear mint. Obverse description: Bare headed bust facing right. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse description: Figure standing left with letters SC. Reverse inscription: Illegible. Coin measures: 27.14 mm in diameter, 3.87 mm in thickness, and 12.22g in weight
